notes: Prohibition on marketing materials in which PFAS have been used. Section 8(2) permits a functional barrier that prevents migration to food. No concentration number or zero threshold is stated by section 8. Section 25 gives entry into force on July 1, 2020 and a stock transition for qualifying materials marketed before that date. Original 2020 edition; later legal consolidation requires review. Ban must not be converted into a numeric ICS ceiling.

section: Subdivision 5(a)(1); subdivisions 1, 5(b), 8
notes: Published category: carpets or rugs. Sale, offer for sale and distribution prohibition begins January 1, 2025. No numeric concentration threshold.
